notes: Failed incomplete cases are not complete-operation speed records.
Claude includes native cache reads/writes; DeepSeek sums native step totalTokens; Qwen uses prompt_eval_count+eval_count.
Only compare arms within one model; these counters are not API prices.
Wall time sums model turns including MCP/CLI setup; fixture setup, fault injection, operator approval and independent checks excluded.
Initial/revised development used to find defects; brief regression/build commands overlapped some timings.
Terminal-guard-qwen repeats Qwen after fixed-image normalization and verified-continue completion handling.
Final-receipt-qwen repeats the same four cases after retaining the applied plan receipt during read-only readiness polling.
The last two Qwen cohorts apply the same empty-response retry and completed-continue stop policy to both arms; all attempts count in token/time totals.
Host completion is not evidence that the model stopped on its own; this is an MCP interface comparison with a shared host policy, not unmodified alpha.11 sw chat.
One fixed-image-memory-limited case never started due to low host memory; it is neither a model success nor failure.
No unplanned rescue was offered. Zero rescue offered does not mean failed cases needed no help.
Exact DeepSeek model ID not observed; requested deepseek-v4-pro/high.
Native token totals count cache fields according to provider, not API price.
